biggest_catch: The friend must join using YOUR unique referral link - if they apply any other way, even by walking into a branch, nobody gets paid.
catches: Any existing member in good standing can participate by sharing their personal referral link.
For each friend you refer who becomes a member using your referral link, both you and your friend receive a $50 Amazon eGift Card.
You can earn up to $500 in Amazon eGift Cards per calendar year (10 successful referrals).
Referred friends must meet the eligibility criteria for opening a new Members 1st account and must not have been a member within the past 12 months.
Current members and joint owners do not qualify as prospective members; Members 1st associates, volunteers and officials are not eligible.
The offer cannot be combined with any other offer.
Bonuses are reported to the IRS for income tax purposes; Members 1st will issue a 1099 or other appropriate tax form.
